# PLG — Product Led Growth

`sales.model.plg` · model · parent `—`

> The product acquires and converts; sellers arrive after usage exists. Qualification inverts entirely — instead of asking whether they might buy, we can see what they already do.


## Characteristics

|  |  |
|---|---|
| buyer | an existing user who becomes an economic buyer |
| typical_cycle_days | 14 |
| decision_style | bottom-up adoption, top-down approval only at scale |
| primary_channels | `in_product`, `email` |


## Deactivates

- `sales.prospecting_and_outreach.cold_calling`


## Emphasises

- `sales.post_sale_and_growth.onboarding`
- `sales.post_sale_and_growth.expansion`
- `sales.post_sale_and_growth.upsell`
- `sales.revenue_operations.revenue_intelligence`


## Extends `sales.obj.core.icp`


> In PLG, fit is observed from usage rather than inferred from firmographics. The behavioural half of the ICP outranks the firmographic half, reversing the usual weighting.
